given: the up migration has added and backfilled batch_number/serial_number and its integrity probe has run
when: the post-migration stock table schema is inspected
then: the inventory_code column no longer exists on the stock table, and the drop occurred only after the add and backfill and probe steps (add -> backfill -> probe -> drop)
architectural_notes: Infra schema-shape contract realized by NFR-F6-7-additive-rollout-safety: the destructive drop is gated on the completed additive backfill and integrity probe, so the irreversible step runs only after integrity is observed. Verified by an R4/NFR-F6-4 real-branch post-migration schema inspection asserting inventory_code is absent.

independence.rationale: AC1-AC4 assert backfill values, survival, and the probe while inventory_code still exists; AC5 asserts the final removal of inventory_code and the add->backfill->probe->drop ordering. The drop can fail or run too early (column still present, or dropped before backfill) while the backfill/survival/probe are correct, and vice versa
